## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also describe relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Security hardening / performance optimization

## Pre-Submission Verification Checklist
Before submitting this pull request, please verify:
- [ ] My code follows the Swiss Apple black-and-white minimalist design language of this project.
- [ ] I have executed `npx tsc --noEmit` in `mobile/` and verified **0 errors**.
- [ ] I have executed `npx expo-doctor` in `mobile/` and verified all checks pass.
- [ ] I have executed `npm test` in `backend/` and verified all tests pass.
- [ ] No hardcoded passwords, tokens, or personal secrets are committed.
- [ ] Any new documentation matches the actual codebase implementation.
